title: Expansion Kit course (last to green)
notes: Scenario 3 of the C-R2.3 matrix. An Expansion Kit (64DD) course. Contract note: EK is the
LAST scenario expected to go green — it exercises the disk audio-table path and the EK-only
boot sequencing, so it is the most likely to surface a residual nondeterminism after 1 and 2
pass. The autoinput file is a PLACEHOLDER (NEEDS-RECORDING). Requires the EK disk mounted
(the same first-boot data the normal EK build needs).
